reader_sentence: Across GPT-2 small, Pythia-410M and Gemma-2-2B, integrated gradients matches per-head ablation effects best (mean Spearman ρ ≈ 0.84), ahead of attribution patching (0.62), gradient × input (0.45) and saliency (0.29), while activation magnitude does worst (0.18) and is the only method whose evidence is weak on every model (BF₁₀ < 10).
intended: Integrated gradients matches ablation best on all three models (rank correlation about 0.8 to 0.9), clearly ahead of the next best method, attribution patching (about 0.6).
reason: The summary says integrated gradients matches ablation best across all three models (ρ ≈ 0.84), clearly ahead of attribution patching (≈ 0.62); the extra detail on other methods doesn't contradict that.
